page.overview:
What is Toad God?

The Toad God is a fictional entity, created by Robert E. Howard for his short story "The Thing on the Roof".

The Toad God used to be worshipped by an ancient tribe in Central America, during the pre-Columbian era. A temple was built for the deity, where it laid dormant for thousands of years. However, the temple also contains a mummy wearing a toad-shaped jewel. If the jewel is removed and used to open the hidden door, the Toad God will awaken to curse whoever disturbed it. (: "The Thing on the Roof")

After appearing in their adaptation of the original story, the Toad God was incorporated into the Marvel Multiverse, where it would be established as being either a Great Old One or Lesser Old One. (: Official Handbook of the Marvel Universe A to Z #3; Demons' profile)
